description:
Prepared M-grouped contiguous/PSUM GEMM; no per-expert Python launch loop. Stored payload/scales and native caller output are unchanged. General source-derived inputs; no serving deployment or measured traffic.

Production entry: deep_gemm.m_grouped_fp8_fp4_gemm_nt_contiguous; fixed source revision e1f418c2a4f20818221f6b0e578b4c2f634d4c3f.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Dispatched physical rows sum to M<=65536; each group has 0..8192 rows, aligned to 128. Logical rows cannot exceed physical capacity. For the FlashInfer segmented paths, logical_group_sizes is descriptive: all physical rows are computed; it does not imply masked execution. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: Retain workload-v3 full projection/expert N/K geometry, legitimate small-M decode, long normal prefill, original physical group capacities, logical row counts, masking, alias and stress branches. FC2 activations for N/K=(4096,12288),(7168,2048),(4096,1536) are generated as SiLU(gate)*up with gate/up correlation .25, producing asymmetric heavy-tailed inputs. Projection/FC1 activations use Gaussian innovations with channel gains .65..1.35; weights use fan-in scaling, channel gains .65..1.35 and row gains .7..1.3. Existing channel-outlier controls remain. All profiles are quantized by the existing actual payload/scale encoder, so cross-group dynamic range reaches the operator. Before-quantization mean/RMS/absmax/third moment summaries describe up to 262144 sampled elements; correctness reads only stored payload/scale. The model configuration sources also define the MoE FC1 [2I,H]/FC2 [H,I] widths; selected TP shards are explicitly distinct from full-I configurations. Constant weights stay unchanged within an evaluation; no cold-cache or end-to-end layer-performance claim is made.

d.alias: caller-owned buffer; documented optional C alias; nonwrite storage unchanged

validation.correctness_scope: Original library, validation_scope=sampled, SM103; fixed shape IDs 0-9, at most 2 recorded seeds per shape. 采样通过. Counts={'passed': 20}. No prior patched results inherited. Shared-GPU timings are execution checks only.

limitations: No deployment-specific frequency or device-time weight is claimed.

real_inputs.reason: General source-derived shapes and stored-precision synthetic payloads; real traffic is not part of this core contract.
